attestations.text: CH'I Chün-tsao 祁寯藻 (T. 叔穎, 淳[實]甫, H. 春圃, 觀齋), 1793–1866, Oct. 20, official and poet, native of Shou-yang, Shansi, was the fifth son of Ch'i Yün-shih [q. v.]. Ch'i Chün-tsao was brought up in Peking, but when his father was exiled to Chinese Turkestan in 1805 he and his mother went back to his native place.
